body:
After reading up on Blue Lotus, I decided to try it for myself. I purchased 1oz online and waited for its arrival. I chose Blue Lotus after reading numerous reports of its desired effects, and few to none reporting negative effects. It is known for its very mild sedative, calming effect. I am a calm person to begin with, so I figured if the effects were really as mild as many describe, I should be able to sense them with my already calm personality.
When researching the correct dosage to smoke, the amount seems to be all over the place; from a ½ gram to 15 grams. This is because herbs can effect different people in different ways, regardless of body weight. To test myself for any negative/allergic reactions I might have, I chose to start with 1.5g. I broke the Lotus into 2 parts of .75g apiece. My personality is inverted and easygoing and I am not under any particularly  excessive stresses, or any feelings of depression etc during this.  Here is my report:
>10:45pm I roll up .75g lotus and smoked it.
>11:15pm Felt overall calmer than I did before. Something like tobacco. I was outside in the dark.  Though not fond  of the dark, I felt ok.
>11:45pm An hour passed since the first joint. No negative effects experienced at this point, in fact nothing much at all other than feeling calm, so I rolled the other .75g of lotus and smoked it. Went inside to my bedroom.
>11:55pm-12:45am I stayed up for about an hour. Here are commonly written Blue Lotus effects that I personally did not feel at all: colors more vibrant, intoxicated feeling like alcohol without dizziness and mental fog, warmth around head and upper body, mild hallucinations, elevated feeling of happiness, fatigue.  I lay down at 12:45am to sleep feeling like I had done nothing more than smoked a cigarette or two. If someone had told me that outside in the dark, I had actually smoked 2 cigarettes, I would have believed them. The only difference was that Blue Lotus tastes better than tobacco.
The only difference was that Blue Lotus tastes better than tobacco.
>1:30am Woke up feeling like I had to urinate. For a moment it was as if I felt maybe 100lbs heavier in bed, which was unusual. But after getting out of bed I did not feel it again. I went into the next partially lit room heading for the bathroom. Walking towards the ceiling light pull chain (it was dark but I could see due to another light nearby) it momentarily felt as if I needed to take an extra few steps to reach the pull chain than normal. Weird, either like time slowed, or I had to reach extrrraaa far to grab hold of the pull chain. That was a strange feeling. Used the bathroom but not much came out. I would like to exaggerate and say I saw mad hallucinations and it was a perfect replacement for weed, like many seem to experience. The moment of heaviness and funky feeling reaching for the pull switch were the only trippy things that stood out for me. Sorry for the bore...  But Im glad I didnt take more than 1.5g or sleep might have been a wee bit worse. I went back to bed and lay down.  Every time I fell asleep it was as if I had a very slight muscle twitch somewhere deep inside of me that would jolt me out of sleep. Happened every 5 minutes or so? I also had this very brief (½ to 1 second) little split headaches that would come and go with the muscle twitch. It was intense,  but more irritating than anything.  If it wasnt the muscle twitch waking me up, it was the quick pierce of pain that came and went.
>3:22am A light bulb of smartness lit in my mind and I was like hey, we have pain pills around. Duhh Took one acetaminophen which seemed to help as I was able to fall asleep around
>4am. Around this time I finally began  to sleep without interruption.
This all happened last night. In retrospect, I do not believe anything I experienced as far as head pain, twitching while sleeping, and calmness prior to sleeping, were due to any placebo or pre-conceived anxiety. Start to finish I never felt anxious. I did feel calm, though not overly. I definitely felt many brief muscle spasms and stabs of head pain. The spasms and head pain were brief so they were more annoying at the time because I was trying to sleep.  Now at 2:15 pm the next afternoon, I still feel the head pain as a very mild but throbbing sort of headache. Not sure about the weird heaviness and the feeling at the light switch. I can say I definitely experience something because though I was groggy, I had to actually pinch myself to see if I was lucid dreaming, which I was not. So there was definitely a little something out of the ordinary. Like I said in the beginning, herbs or drugs will effect different people in different ways sometimes regardless of bodyweight. Rarely if at all have I read a review that mentioned negative effects of smoking Blue Lotus, so that is what compelled me to write this. I still have a lot of blue Lotus left so and intend to try some more.
